Python code:

import requests
import re

orcids = ['0000-0002-1825-0097', '0000-0001-5000-0007', '0000-0003-1234-5678', '0000-0002-9876-5432', '0000-0001-2345-6789']

counts = {}
year_pattern = re.compile(r'(19\d{2}|20\d{2})')

for oid in orcids:
    url = f'https://orcid.org/{oid}'
    try:
        resp = requests.get(url, timeout=10)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        years = [int(y) for y in year_pattern.findall(resp.text) if y.isdigit()]
        pre2020 = sum(1 for y in years if y < 2020)
        counts[oid] = pre2020
    except Exception:
        counts[oid] = None

print('Pre-2020 works count per ORCID (scraped):')
print(counts)

# Compute average excluding None
vals = [v for v in counts.values() if isinstance(v, int)]
if vals:
    avg = sum(vals)/len(vals)
    print('Average pre-2020 works:', round(avg, 2))
else:
    print('Average pre-2020 works: N/A')
